check_questions.q: You type python, then at >>> type git --version and get an error. Why, and how do you get Git's version?
check_questions.note: Correct: not Python code; exit() then run at $ prompt.

check_questions.q: Which tool would you use to (a) edit a file, (b) run it, (c) save a snapshot, (d) ask why an error happened? Variant: in 'python hello.py', which word is the program doing the work?
check_questions.note: a/c/d right. Said the Git Bash terminal runs code instead of Python; on the variant he named hello.py as an argument but not python as the program. Terminal vs interpreter role still shaky; the task's Python purpose line will practise it.
